act_title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
title: Civil court not to have jurisdiction
text:
72. Civil court not to have jurisdiction.—No civil court shall have jurisdiction to entertain any suit

or proceeding in respect of any matter which an Adjudicating Officer or the Tribunal is empowered by or
under this Act to determine and no injunction shall be granted by any court or other authority in respect of
any action taken or to be taken in pursuance of any power conferred by or under this Act.
